messages.content: QA gate on the current working tree returned **require_approval** (11 medium `change.missing-tests`, 16 unmapped sources, suite not runnable). Exact gap and unblock steps are in the description. Re-run `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` and post the output here when the tests cover the changed modules.

QA evidence addendum (2026-11-17 shift, comment only — no engine run requested).

1) WHY THIS VERDICT BLOCKS DELIVERY (contract, not opinion)
`docs/delivery-contract.md:45-51` makes the QA gate mandatory at both tiers:

  | `agile` (codx-junior, default) | Targeted tests for the touched files (or a manual
    reproduction when there are none) + `qa_review_changes`. A `warn` verdict is acceptable
    **only** if the gap is named in **Next tasks**. |
  | `max` (codx-junior-max) | Full test suite + coverage threshold + `security_review_changes`
    + browser explorer for UI changes. |

  "a delivery without its tier's validation is not a delivery."

The current verdict is `require_approval` (11 x change.missing-tests) and the runtime gate
returns `block` (tests.no-suite). `require_approval` is NOT `warn`, so per the contract the
increment above cannot be delivered/closed as-is. The gap must be named in Next tasks AND
the tests added — the first is documentation, only the second closes it.

2) SUITE DETECTION IS NOT THE CAUSE (probe result)
`qa_run_tests(suite="pytest", timeout=120)` -> decision: block, highest_severity: high,
  1 finding: [high] tests.no-suite @ -: "Add a pytest/npm test setup, or declare the command
  in `qa_policy.suites`: {"unit": {"command": ["make", "test"]}}"
So the gate cannot resolve a suite by name either: only a declared `qa_policy.suites` entry
(or an auto-detected pytest/npm setup at the configured project root) will make it run.
The QA project root is the docs folder, which contains no python/js test setup — that is why
the pytest files in the parent repo are invisible to the gate.

3) No failing test ids to report: nothing executed. Do not read that as "green".

Owner: software_developer (qa_policy.suites + coverage report) / qa_automation (tests naming
the 13 changed modules). Re-verify with: qa_review_changes(scope="all") then qa_run_tests(suite="auto").

QA correction to this card's gap statement — 2026-11-17, turn 4 (comment only, no engine run).

My original gap text said the 3 new pytest files "map to 0 changed sources — they do not name the modules they cover". **That inference was not evidenced and I retract it.** I could not read the test bodies at all (`project_read_file` refuses paths outside the `docs/` project root), so "they do not name the modules" was a guess dressed as a finding. QA does not report guesses.

What is evidenced:
- `repository_status`: the 3 test files are staged **with** the product modules they target (efforts API, effort_manager, model/effort) — correct delivery shape.
- `qa_review_changes(scope="all")`: `test_files: 0`, `mapped_sources: 0`, `unmapped_sources: 16`, 11 x `change.missing-tests`.
- `project_changes(paths=["api/tests"])`: "No changes found" (docs root).

So the 11 `change.missing-tests` findings are a **limitation of the mapping layer** (two git roots: QA diffs the parent repo, discovery is pinned to `docs/`), not proof of missing coverage. Unproven either way.

REVISED VERDICT for this card, unchanged in outcome:
```
## Decision: require_approval
- Scope: working tree scope="all" (parent repo codx-junior-platform): 12 staged + 27 unstaged files
- Evidence: qa_review_changes -> require_approval, 11 x change.missing-tests, test_files 0 (but 3 test

  qa_coverage -> no report. Failing test ids: none — nothing could be executed.

- Blocking item: no suite declared, and the mapping layer cannot see api/tests -> nothing is measurable

```
The gap is now precise: **make the gate see the tests**, then re-measure. Nobody should write new tests on the basis of the 11 findings until `test_files` is non-zero.

## PM note — sequencing (shift 1, 2026-11-17)

**Status: BLOCKED-BY `3fb379ae` (no test suite declared).** This card is a *finding*, not a work item of its own. Do not touch it until the gate can actually measure tests.

**Owner:** software_developer (same owner as the blocker). Due 2026-11-19, wake 2026-11-19.

### Why it is one increment, not two
Fixing `qa_policy.suites` makes `qa_run_tests` return real counts instead of `tests.no-suite`. That single change should move this verdict from `require_approval` with `mapped_sources: 0`, `unmapped_sources: 16`, `test_files: 0` to a measurable ratio. Re-slicing it into "declare the suite" + "map sources" would produce a milestone that cannot be demoed — so it stays one card, closed by evidence.

### Definition of Done for this card
1. Blocker card `3fb379ae` is Done (suite declared, command output pasted).
2. `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` re-run on the same working tree returns a real `mapped_sources` count — or an explicit, documented "no measurable sources" instead of silence.
3. Both outputs pasted into this card **before** it moves to Done.

### Scope for this increment
- In: the 45-file working tree (efforts + atlas changes) reviewed against a real suite; the 11 `change.missing-tests` either covered, or each one named with a reason.
- Out: refactoring the atlas/effort code itself, and any test-writing that belongs to a separate delivery.

If the blocker slips past 2026-11-19, this card slips with it — that trade-off is already recorded, nothing is absorbed silently.

Neither this card nor its fix card can be verified from here until the re-homing decision on `3fb379ae` is taken (default option A, 2026-11-18).

What stays valid regardless of where the work runs:

- The 11 `change.missing-tests` split into two very different groups: 6 backend (`ai/smol/effort.py`, `api/efforts.py`, `atlas/related.py`, `efforts/__init__.py`, `efforts/effort_manager.py`, `model/effort.py`) which are coverable with the existing pytest setup, and 5 front-end (`api.js`, `modules/efforts.js`, `EffortsSettings.vue`, `TeamMemberCard.vue`, `TeamMemberDrawer.vue`, `config.js`, `GlobalSettings.vue`) which have **no JS test runner in the repo at all**.
- Decision still open (default A): accept a named, reasoned exemption for the front-end paths in this increment and schedule a JS test runner as its own increment later. Decide by 2026-11-19.
